payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precalculate suffix maximum of segment sums, then scan each left segment and pair with best non-overlapping right segment using the precomputed array.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 1D array maxSeg where maxSeg[i] = index of maximum segment sum from i to end, computed via a simple recurrence: maxSeg[i] = max_by_sum(maxSeg[i], maxSeg[i+1]). This is a classic 1D DP optimization for finding two non-overlapping intervals.
